name: Harvard University Center for the Environment Environmental Fellows
funder: Harvard University Center for the Environment (HUCE)
amount: USD 92,000/year salary + USD 2,500/year professional allowance + up to USD 2,500 relocation
other_rules: Doctorate awarded within the window set for the cohort (2027 cohort: May 2023 to August 2027)
research on the environment in any discipline
Harvard PhDs eligible only if moving into significantly new directions
notes: About 5 fellows a year. 2027 cohort deadline 1 Dec 2026.
